title: Placed Consumer Accounts: Portal Credit-Card Limit for Medical Debts by Final-Bill Age
content:
Client Services schedule note for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the portal credit-card limit, the card-payment amount the portal credit-card ceiling of the day starts from, which depends on whether the debt is medical and how old its final bill is.

## Schedule note

The portal credit-card limit is **$3000.00** for a medical debt whose charge-off or final-bill date is fewer than 365 calendar days before the handling date or that has no such date, **$4000.00** for a medical debt whose charge-off or final-bill date is 365 or more calendar days before the handling date, and **the stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum** for any debt that is not medical.

| Debt type recorded on the account | Charge-off or final-bill date recorded on the account | Portal credit-card limit |
|---|---|---|
| Medical | None | $3000.00 |
| Medical | Fewer than 365 calendar days before the handling date | $3000.00 |
| Medical | 365 or more calendar days before the handling date | $4000.00 |
| Any other debt type | any | The stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum |

The age is the plain count of calendar days from the charge-off or final-bill date to the handling date.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

*Handling date 2026-10-10; the accounts are invented.*

| Debt | Final-bill date | Calendar days to 2026-10-10 | Limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medical | 2025-10-10 | 365 | $4000.00 |
| Medical | 2025-10-11 | 364 | $3000.00 |
| Medical, no final-bill date recorded | none | not applicable | $3000.00 |
| Telecom | 2023-02-01 | over 365 | The stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum |

Both dollar figures apply at every stage that accepts credit cards; only the non-medical row follows the stage.
